summary.text: G. Mark Norman is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Tammy Carpenter (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Norman described himself as a Navy veteran, veterinarian and former small-business owner.

paragraphs.text: G. Mark Norman attended Keokuk High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the United States Naval Academy in 1980, and later earned a degree from Iowa State University in 1996.
Ballotpedia lists his U.S. Navy service as 1980 to 2002 and his profession as veterinarian.

In his Ballotpedia survey, Norman said he served on active duty and in the Navy Reserve and retired as a captain after 22 years, then practiced veterinary medicine in Oregon for nearly 30 years and helped build a local veterinary hospital.
Norman advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
In his survey, he said he opposes unnecessary tax increases, supports fully staffing law enforcement, and favors directing education resources to classrooms and addressing chronic absenteeism.
He also named veterans' issues, small-business growth, health care access and animal welfare among the policy areas he is passionate about.
